_comment: Harness case H-COL-002: FetchResult for a source that returns HTTP 404 on the first attempt. The error is marked retryable=false so the collector immediately stops retrying and records the failure. Used to verify that 4xx client errors are not retried.

attempt_log.error_detail: Server returned 404 Not Found for URL https://www.polygon.com/rss/news/index.xml. Response body (first 256 chars): '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><title>404 - Page Not Found | Polygon</title>...'

diagnostic_note: Source URL may have been moved or deprecated. The RSS feed path '/rss/news/index.xml' no longer exists on the Polygon domain. Consider updating the source configuration to use the current feed URL.
